name: Visa-free entry (up to 60 days)
summary: Citizens of about 50 countries can enter without a visa for up to 60 days, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, most EU states and several Gulf states. Belarus, Kazakhstan, Russia and Tajikistan have no stay limit stated.

other: Check the exact country list and day count with the foreign ministry before travel.

name: Visa-free under bilateral agreements
summary: Malaysia gets 30 days. Turkey and Uzbekistan get 60 days. Ukraine and Mongolia get 90 days.

name: Kyrgyzstan eVisa
summary: Apply online with scanned documents and pay by card. No embassy visit. Every traveler, including children, needs their own eVisa. It gives the same entry right as a sticker visa.

other: Fee and stay length not confirmed. Use the Do I need a visa tool on the portal.
